title: Value
description: A runtime value produced by evaluating a statement. Phase 1 supports three variants: 64-bit signed integer, UTF-8 text, and SQL NULL. Phase 6g adds Real (IEEE-754 double-precision float). In the JSON-encoded fixtures, a bare integer is Integer; a JSON number containing a `.` or an exponent is Real; a JSON string is Text; JSON null is SQL NULL.

oneOf.description: Phase 6g: IEEE-754 double-precision float (distinguished from integer by the presence of a decimal point or exponent in the JSON encoding).
